name: message-branch-selector
title: MessageBranchSelector
description: Controlled navigator across alternative message branches (e.g. regenerated responses): '‹ 2 / 5 ›' with prev/next Buttons (accessible labels 'Previous branch' / 'Next branch'). Fully controlled — the consumer owns index and reacts to onPrev/onNext; regenerate/streaming is a platform concern. Prev is disabled at the first branch, next at the last; a single branch (count <= 1) renders nothing. Composes Button — zero new dependency.
